t: What Decision Postmortem Database Is All About
title: What Decision Postmortem Database Is All About
description: Decision postmortems review the choice: the decision (what was decided), the reasoning (why), the outcome (what happened), and the lesson (what's learned). Separate outcome from quality: good decisions can fail (luck), bad can succeed. The premortem: imagine the failure first. Decide well; learn always. This database is the complete decision postmortem: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
